div.head: Af 11
div.ab: XII. Gif mon on cyrliscre fæmnon breost gefó, mid V scll' hire gebete.
XII. Gif mon on cirliscre fæmnan breost gefó, mid V scill. hire gebete.
Si quis cyrliscre femine pectus apprehendat, quinque solidis emendetur ei.
{XII} Gif mon on cirliscre fæmnan breost gefó, mid V scill hire gebete.
If a man seizes a ceorl-woman on the breast, let him recompense her with 5 shillings.
If anyone seizes by the breast a young woman belonging to the commons, he shall pay her 5 shillings compensation.
Wenn jemand an die Brust einer gemeinfreien Jungfrau fasst, büsse er ihr mit 5 Schill.
If someone seizes the breast of a common-free girl, let him pay her 5 shillings.

note.label: cf.
note.quote: Carole Hough, adducing §29 (in which a man who rapes a female slave must pay 5 shillings restitution plus the 60 shilling fine required by §11)

note.label: cf.
